violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MAC AND CHEESE AT 128F IN FWE 1 DOOR UPRIGHT HOT HOLDING CABINET.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REHEAT FOODS TO 165F OR ABOVE FOR HOT HOLDING AT 135F. EMPLOYEE REHEATED FOODS TO 166F DURING INSPECTION. NAVY ELEMENTARY SCHOOL (Inspection Date: 08/28/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: VICTORY 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR AT 49-55F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PLACED WORK ORDER FOR REPAIR DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOODS TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW. EMAIL EHS ONCE REPAIR HAS BEEN COMPLETED.
